reference: If he hadn't tipped the barrel, the fish would still be here.
sk: Keby ten sud nebol prevrátil, ryby by tu ešte boli.
cz: Kdyby ten sud nepřevrhl, ryby by tu ještě byly.
acceptable: If he hadn't {tipped|tipped over|knocked over|overturned} {the|that} barrel, the fish would still be here.
If he hadn't {tipped|knocked} {the|that} barrel over, the fish would still be here.
The fish would still be here if he hadn't {tipped|tipped over|knocked over|overturned} {the|that} barrel.
The fish would still be here if he hadn't {tipped|knocked} {the|that} barrel over.

mistakes.text: If he didn't tip the barrel, the fish would still be here.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Prevrátenie suda je v minulosti, preto po „if“ patrí Past Perfect: „hadn't tipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Převrhnutí sudu je v minulosti, proto po „if“ patří Past Perfect: „hadn't tipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Tipping the barrel happened in the past, so the if-clause needs the Past Perfect: “hadn't tipped”.

mistakes.text: If he hadn't tipped the barrel, the fish would still have been here.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ryby by tu boli teraz, preto v hlavnej vete: „would still be here“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ryby by tu byly teď, proto v hlavní větě: „would still be here“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The fish would be here now, so the main clause needs “would still be here”.

mistakes.text: If he wouldn't have tipped the barrel, the fish would still be here.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „if“ nepatrí „would“; správne je Past Perfect: „if he hadn't tipped“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „if“ nepatří „would“; správně je Past Perfect: „if he hadn't tipped“.
mistakes.feedback_en: No “would” after “if”; use the Past Perfect: “if he hadn't tipped”.

mistakes.text: If he hadn't tipped the barrel, the fishes would still be here.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Množné číslo od „fish“ je bežne tiež „fish“, nie „fishes“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Množné číslo od „fish“ je běžně také „fish“, ne „fishes“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The usual plural of “fish” is “fish”, not “fishes”.

mistakes.text: If he hadn't tipped the barrel, the fish would be still here.
